title: Polite retries back off exponentially and roll dice
body: If every client retries instantly after an outage, the recovering service is DDoSed by its own customers in lockstep. Exponential backoff spaces attempts, and random jitter desynchronises the herd into a manageable drizzle. Amazon's builders call this a load-bearing best practice. Distributed politeness is an algorithm, and its name is jitter.
source_hint: AWS Builders' Library, timeouts and backoff with jitter
